name: com.nightmarquee/studio
title: NightMarquee Studio
description: Make your own version of a cinematic website's footage, with your brand and product.

tools.name: search_designs
tools.description: Lists the designs a scene can be made of, with a title, tagline, category, a poster, a short preview clip and a live demo link for each. Filter by words or category and page through the results with the cursor. Use it to find a design, then pass its slug to create_scene. It needs no scope beyond the connection.

query.description: Words to look for in a design's title, tagline, description, style keywords, category and the businesses it suits, such as restaurant, hotel or florist.

category.description: A category slug from the `categories` list of an earlier search. An unknown category returns no designs.

tier.description: Only free designs, or only designs that need a plan.

kind.description: The kind of design. Only `site` exists today; any other kind returns no designs.

limit.description: How many designs to return, 1 to 50. The default is 10.

cursor.description: The `cursor` from the previous result, to read the next page.

tools.name: create_scene
tools.description: Starts the connected account's own scene of a design, with the brand name and the product to put in place of the design's own subject (on a design whose subject is a character, describe the character instead). Free: nothing is spent. Returns the scene id, whether the scene takes a product photo, and the next step.

brand.description: The brand's name, as the page should show it.

product.description: What the scene shows in place of its own subject, in a few words, for example "a green glass bottle of olive oil".

tools.name: start_photo_upload
tools.description: Returns a link for the user to open in a browser, where they add one photo of their product to this scene. The link works once, for 15 minutes, and needs no sign-in. Give the link to the user, then call get_scene to see the photo once it is ready. Only scenes whose subject is a product take a photo.

tools.name: add_photo_from_url
tools.description: Adds the scene's product photo from a public https address of an image the user already has online. The photo is checked, cleaned of its metadata and screened as an upload is, then used by the scene's next take. A JPEG, PNG, WebP or HEIC of at most 15 MB, at least 512 pixels on its shorter side. Only scenes whose subject is a product take a photo.

rights.description: True only once the user has confirmed the photo is of their own product, or one they have the right to use, and that anyone shown in it agreed to be in it. Needed before the account's first photo.

tools.name: get_scene
tools.description: Reads one of the connected account's scenes: its brand and product, whether it takes a product photo and whether one is ready, each take with a link to its image, the picked take, the film and what to do next. Links last 10 minutes.

tools.name: quote
tools.description: Prices a take, the film (shoot, with or without the sharper finish) or filming one shot again (redo) for one of the connected account's scenes, with the credit balance, the balance after, any shortfall and how much of today's limit is left. Spends nothing. Returns a quote id that lasts 10 minutes: show the user the price, and only after they agree, pass the id to confirm_spend.

action.description: take: one picture of the scene's first frame. shoot: the film, from the picked take. redo: one shot of the finished film filmed again.

sharper.description: For shoot only: the sharper finish, which costs more. A redo follows the film's own finish.

shot.description: For redo only: the number of the shot to film again, from 1.

tools.name: confirm_spend
tools.description: Spends the credits a quote priced and starts the work it priced: a take, the film or a redo. Call it only after the user agreed to that quote's price. Apps that can ask the user show them the price and ask before anything is spent. Returns the job; read it with get_job. The same quote never spends twice: calling again answers the same job.

quote.description: The quote id from quote, which the user agreed to.

tools.name: pick_take
tools.description: Picks one of the scene's ready takes as the first frame its film is made from. Show the user the takes first and pick the one they choose.

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Returns the status of a take, a film or a redo started by confirm_spend, given its job id. While the status is queued or running, wait the number of seconds in retryAfterSeconds and call again. A finished take returns a link to its image, which lasts 10 minutes. Read-only.

id.description: The job id returned by confirm_spend, for example take_ followed by a uuid.

tools.name: list_scenes
tools.description: Lists the scenes the connected account has finished, newest first: each scene's id, its design's slug, a title, when it was finished and whether it used a product photo. Filter by a design's slug and page through the results with the cursor. Pass a scene id to get_footage to download that scene's footage.

slug.description: Only the scenes of this design, by its slug from search_designs.

limit.description: How many scenes to return, 1 to 50. The default is 10.

cursor.description: The `cursor` from the previous result, to read the next page.

tools.name: get_footage
tools.description: Returns short-lived download links for the clips and images of a scene the connected account has finished, with each file's role and the starter file it replaces. The links last ten minutes. Pass a scene id from list_scenes and its design's slug.

slug.description: The scene's design slug, from list_scenes.

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Returns the connected account's credit balance, how many credits are held for work in progress and how many credits are left of today's limit. Read-only. Credits are added on nightmarquee.com, not here.
